warningSigns: Feeling hopeless, trapped, or like a burden to others
Withdrawing from friends, family, and texts/calls
Sleeping too much or severe insomnia / racing thoughts at night
Sudden numbness, dissociation, or feeling disconnected from my body
Sensory sensitivity increasing (lights, sounds, textures feeling unbearable)
Skipping meals, hydration, or prescribed medications
Increased urges to self-harm or use substances to numb out
Intrusive thoughts of death, disappearing, or giving away belongings
Physical tension: tight chest, shallow breathing, clenched jaw, nausea
Stop engaging in hobbies, hygiene, or daily routines
Ruminating on past trauma, shame, or conflict
copingStrategies: TIPP Skill: Cold water on face / holding an ice cube for 30 seconds
5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding (5 things I see, 4 feel, 3 hear, 2 smell, 1 taste)
Paced Breathing (Inhale for 4 seconds, exhale slowly for 6–8 seconds)
Progressive Muscle Relaxation (tensing and releasing muscle groups)
Wrap up in a weighted blanket or heavy hoodie in a dim, quiet room
Put on noise-canceling headphones or a comfort playlist/audiobook
Take a warm shower or bath to reset physical temperature
Spend time with my pet (petting, brushing, or walking them)
Step outside for 5 minutes of fresh air and look at the sky/trees
Drink a full glass of cold water or make a warm cup of herbal tea
Engage in intense brief movement (jumping jacks, brisk walk, stretching)
Write down racing thoughts on paper or use a worry journal
Watch a familiar comfort show or play a cozy video game for distraction
Use safe sensory stims (rocking, fidget tools, textured fabric, aromatherapy)
